responsibility: Adds compatibility vector type aliases used when adapting VMX/Altivec-oriented source to SPU. Built on top of spu_intrinsics.h, it defines extra single-keyword vector type names such as vec_bchar16, vec_bshort8, vec_pixel8, and vec_bint4 that match PowerPC SIMD naming conventions, supporting the translation layer implemented in vmx2spu.h rather than backend code generation itself.
